enable_acpitool.description: Enable acpitool-based power management automation at boot

wakeup_devices.description: List of wakeup device identifiers (e.g., 'XHC', 'EHC1') to enable at boot; obtained via 'acpitool -w'

fan_mode.description: Fan control mode: '0' for auto, '1' for force-on (Toshiba only)

ultrabay_device.description: Thinkpad ultrabay device identifier to eject at boot (e.g., '0')
